findings.claim: The new helper GetPropertyIdentifierLocation still indexes `property.DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]` directly. Its own doc comment promises it returns null for metadata properties, but it does not. The diagnostic arguments are evaluated before the new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation filter runs, so that filter cannot prevent the crash. This misses the criterion 'Diagnostics that need a source location do not crash when the offending symbol has no declaring syntax'.
